name: Webform MyEmma
description: Webform handler that sends submitted email addresses (with mapped fields) to a MyEmma (Emma) email-marketing group via the judicialcouncil/emma API client; supports a default plus multiple named MyEmma accounts.
project_description:
Integration with MyEmma (Emma) in webforms for Drupal 10.3+/11. Provides a Webform handler that, on a new submission, imports the submitted email address plus mapped webform fields into one or more MyEmma groups. 

 Requirements 
 Requires the Webform module (^6.2 || ^6.3) and installation via Composer to include the judicialcouncil/emma:^4.0 PHP library.

 Installation 
 composer require drupal/webform_myemma .

 Configuration 
 Once the module is enabled: 1) set your MyEmma Account ID, public key and private key at /admin/config/services/webform_myemma (and optionally add named additional accounts); 2) add the MyEmma handler to your webform, where the email element and Group ID are required. Group ID is numeric (found in the URL when viewing a group in your MyEmma account; comma-separate for multiple groups). Select the configured account the handler should use, then map webform elements to MyEmma field shortcuts.
